messages:
Ivy Chen: hey everyone! super excited to join Redwood Inference today 🎉 Remote-first but I'm in Seattle, starting as Solutions Engineer. I love vinyl, sushi, and I'm learning bonsai. my desk is 4A if anyone wants to say hi. ps what's the best lunch spot near the office? :wave:
welcome-bot: Welcome Ivy Chen! Please check the onboarding checklist in #help and ping @Tina (People Ops) for badge access.
Tina (People Ops): Welcome!! we'll do badge, laptop, and stand setup today. Quick Q: do you have any dietary constraints for tomorrow's team lunch? 🥟
Ivy Chen: no allergies, vegetarian-friendly is cool. thanks!
Ben L.: welcome Ivy :tada: there's a great vegetarian sushi place two blocks over — 'Momo Sushi'. order the tempura avocado roll.
Sam P.: +1 Momo. also, vinyl swap on Friday lunchtime? bring records if you want :record_player:
Marina Sato: hey Ivy! I'm bringing a bonsai trimming kit on Friday, happy to share tips. rooftop lunch at 12? ☀️
Harper Lin: welcome! if you like plants we do a micro plant swap in the kitchen on Thursdays. also there's a spare mug with your name on it in the dish rack :coffee:
Ben L.: also help w/ desk network — if your mac complains, run `sudo ifconfig en0 down && sudo ifconfig en0 up` (jk just ping eng-infra if flaky) :upside_down_face:
Ivy Chen: lol noted. thanks for the warm welcome all — see you (virtually) at the rooftop on Friday! :smile:
Marina Sato: adding you to the rooftop slack thread, @Ivy Chen :+1:
Sam P.: welcome again! if you want a lunchtime record recommendation — i vote for some Tokyo synthwave 🎧
Tina (People Ops): badge queued, you should get an email with pickup slot. enjoy your first day!
Ben L.: +1 to sushi and synthwave. also if you need a spare USB-C cable i have extras at desk 2B.
Ivy Chen: omg you guys are amazing. thanks! :sparkles:
